14:00.race_name: Farm And Garden Machinery Ltd Heavy Horsepower Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: His two rivals have better form but he's unexposed and open to improvement; could go well
runners.name: Assertive Walk
runners.owner: Mrs P Bond Magniers Mrs P Shanahan
runners.spotlight: Third in sole bumper (2m, good to soft) and again showed promise when second of four on hurdle debut at Windsor (2m6f, good); his two rivals have better form but he's unexposed and open to improvement; could go well.

runners.comment: Bumper winner who has made the frame on all three hurdle starts; respected
runners.name: Doctor On Call
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner (2m, good to soft) who has made the frame on all three hurdle starts (2m3f/2m4f, good to soft), most recently fourth of 13 at Taunton last month;  there's every chance he'll stay this far and he can give another good account; respected.

runners.comment: 3m point winner who has been runner-up over hurdles on last two starts; leading claims
runners.name: Island Bridge
runners.spotlight: Point winner (3m, heavy) who has been runner-up over hurdles on his last two starts, most recently here (2m5f, good to soft) when just over 4l behind Mondoui'boy, who followed up at Ascot on Saturday; leading claims.

14:33.race_name: Suzuki ATV 'EBF' 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Bumper winner; beaten 11l on switch to hurdles and has to leave that form behind
runners.name: Dartmouth Castle
runners.spotlight: Sedgefield bumper winner on good to firm; coped okay with the soft ground on hurdle debut at Wetherby (2m) but he'll need to step up plenty on that 11l defeat.

runners.comment: Ran better in his second bumper but still beat one home and would be a surprise winner
runners.name: Gimarias
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Mr A Rutherford
runners.spotlight: Ran better in his second bumper but still beat only one home and would be a surprise winner of this.

runners.comment: Has shown nothing in a bumper and two runs over hurdles
runners.name: Hobnail
runners.spotlight: Has shown nothing in a bumper and two runs over hurdles.

runners.comment: Promise in a bumper/on second hurdle start but still doesn't have compelling claims
runners.name: Joeybottles
runners.spotlight: All runs on good to soft; third in a Perth bumper and left his first run over hurdles behind when fourth in a 2m maiden at Southwell (fitted in a first-time tongue-tie); doesn't have compelling claims.

runners.comment: Ex-French 5yo who was last seen finishing second over fences in September
runners.name: Le Gentleman
runners.owner: The North West National Hunt Racing Club
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 5yo who was last seen finishing second over fences in September (2m2f, heavy); tongue-tie is retained after a wind operation; perhaps the stable second string here judged on jockey bookings.

runners.breeder: S C E A Bertwood Stables Et Al
runners.comment: Close third in a French hurdle last April and that form has substance to it
runners.name: Leo Wood
runners.spotlight: Close third in a French hurdle last April when close up behind Brace For Landing who is now with Dan Skelton and has a BHA mark of 118; should have a future for respected new yard.

runners.comment: No real positives to report from runs in three bumpers and two hurdle races
runners.name: River Glance
runners.spotlight: No real positives to report from runs in three bumpers and two hurdle races.

runners.comment: Bumper third didn't amount to much and beaten 35l and 21l over hurdles
runners.name: Swingforthefence
runners.spotlight: His third in a small-field bumper didn't amount to much and has been beaten 35l and 21l over hurdles; one for another day, perhaps.

runners.comment: Tailed off at Ffos Las last time but positives to take from his first two starts
runners.name: Titanium Ring
runners.spotlight: Second in a Hexham bumper and competitive when falling two out in a Uttoxeter maiden (2m, heavy); only 13-2 at Ffos Las 19 days ago but finished well behind on heavy ground; remains capable of better.

runners.comment: Ran okay in a bumper here but has finished pretty much tailed off in two hurdle races
runners.name: Hey Flint
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in a bumper here but has finished pretty much tailed off in two hurdle races, at huge odds.

runners.comment: Second to a talented winner at Windsor; a repeat of that form might be good enough
runners.name: Hornica
runners.spotlight: Hooded from the outset; close up in a Cheltenham bumper and ran her best race yet over hurdles when chasing home a talented Skelton winner at Windsor (2m, soft); a repeat of that form might be good enough.

runners.breeder: P Coutereel D Parreau-Delhote & J Charm
runners.comment: Good French form; beaten fav at Chepstow but ran okay; gets weight from all
runners.name: Misterdoc
runners.spotlight: Four French runs included a bumper win and a length second on hurdle debut; beaten favourite in a juvenile race at Chepstow but wasn't far behind the winner and he's getting weight from all his rivals this time.

15:05.race_name: Meadows And Hynes Mares' Handicap Chase (Challenger Mares' Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Doing well over fences until soft-ground blip latest; could bounce back if conditions suit
runners.name: Minniemum
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-5 over fences with win here (3m1f, good) in November and good Listed second at Market Rasen (3m, good to soft) next time; perhaps unsuited by soft ground when pulled up at Hereford (3m1f, soft) in December last time; could bounce back with a big run if conditions suit.

runners.comment: Won big-field handicap at Cheltenham on last chase start; pulled up in 2m7f hurdle latest
runners.name: Party Vibes
runners.spotlight: Two chase wins last season (2m1f/2m4f, good to soft) and won big-field mares' handicap at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) in December; pulled up back over hurdles at Sandown last time but that was over 2m7f on heavy ground; could play leading role now back down in trip and reverting to fences.

runners.breeder: H Fowler A Frost & C Longsdon
runners.comment: Listed runner-up on last two starts and firmly in calculations now back in a handicap
runners.name: Molto Bene
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Jumping And Ffl Bloodstock
runners.spotlight: Won handicaps in the autumn on first two chase starts (2m4f/2m7f, good/good to soft) and runner-up in Listed races on both outings since, over hurdles at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) and fences at Newbury (2m7f, good to soft); has won on soft ground; firmly in calculations now back in a handicap.

runners.comment: Didn't run badly at Windsor last time but needs something extra to break her chasing duck
runners.name: Georgi Girl
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly when fourth of nine at Windsor (2m4f, soft) last month and she continues to edge down the weights; however, she needs something extra today's if she's to break her chasing duck at the eighth attempt.

runners.comment: Had an excuse for latest effort and she'd been doing well for her new yard previously
runners.name: Theonewedreamof
runners.spotlight: Won at Exeter (3m, good) in November on second stable start before close second of 15 to Party Vibes at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) in December; her run at Hereford seven days later may have come too soon (3m1f, soft; ground shouldn't have been an issue); remains of interest for top yard.

runners.comment: Disappointing at Windsor last month but runner-up on final two outings in 2025
runners.name: Malaita
runners.spotlight: 10yo whose losing sequence is up to 13 after disappointing run at Windsor (2m4f, soft) latest; however, she was runner-up on final two outings in 2025 (2m4f/3m1f, good to soft/soft) and might not be far away if back on song.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten/pulled up on her two outings towards end of last year, after long absence
runners.name: Politacus
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row over hurdles in spring 2024; however, after a long absence she was soundly beaten/pulled up on her two outings towards the end of last year, most recently her chase debut at Uttoxeter; something to prove.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs D & T Futter & Mr B Keogh
runners.comment: Second in this last year and returned to form over C&D in December; on the shortlist
runners.name: Regal Renaissance
runners.spotlight: Two-time course winner (hurdles) who was second in this race last year and returned to form over C&D in December, when she was keeping on in a close third when falling two out; versatile ground-wise; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Two-time French chase winner who could stage major revival on first British chase start
runners.name: Holetown
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in novice hurdles this winter on first two runs for yard; however, this 6yo was a two-time chase winner in France and could stage a major revival now tackling fences in Britain for the first time; interesting.

15:35.race_name: His Royal Highness The Prince Of Wales Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase (Pow Challenge Trophy) (GBB)

runners.comment: On a handy mark on 2024 exploits and perhaps the new cheekpieces will give him a boost
runners.name: Bucksy Des Epeires
runners.spotlight: Below best on his four outings in 2025 and unseated at the first fence at Taunton recently; also needs to prove his stamina; however, this 7yo has plenty of time to get his career back on track and is on a handy mark on his 2024 exploits; perhaps the new cheekpieces will give him a boost.

runners.comment: Returned to form when third in the Tommy Whittle last time and he's entitled to respect
runners.name: Jacks Parrot
runners.spotlight: Returned to form at Haydock (3m1f, soft) two months ago on his second start of the season, finishing third in the competitive Tommy Whittle Chase; this shorter trip isn't an obvious plus but he's respected nevertheless.

runners.comment: Given a chance by the handicapper but tailed off last month following long absence
runners.name: Landen Calling
runners.spotlight: Fourth of 18 at Cheltenham in October 2024 and he's now 8lb lower; however, this 10yo has run just once since, when tailed off at 33-1 at Leicester last month; needs to prove how much ability he retains.

runners.comment: Inconsistent but runner-up at Warwick last time; major player if backing that up
runners.name: The Newest One
runners.spotlight: 11yo who has an up-and-down profile but finished second at Warwick (3m, good to soft) on New Year's Eve; versatile ground-wise; major player if backing up that good performance with another; wears a first-time visor.

runners.comment: Has had wind op since last time and he won after such surgery in 2024; one to consider
runners.name: Petty Cash
runners.spotlight: Second at Chepstow (2m3f, good to soft) in November following a year off and reportedly made a respiratory noise when below par at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to soft) in December; has had wind op since and he won after such surgery in November 2024 (2m7f, good to soft); handles soft; one to consider.

runners.comment: Market check advised on chase debut but pulled up over hurdles on last two starts
runners.name: Vee Dancer
runners.owner: K P Marsh Plastering & Interiors Ltd
runners.spotlight: Point runner-up who is one to watch in the market in first-time blinkers (replacing cheekpieces) on his chase debut; however, this 11yo has been pulled up over hurdles on his last two runs and a major turnaround is needed.

runners.comment: He needs a bigger run today but this 8yo has raced only five times and is in top hands
runners.name: Dyno Dave
runners.spotlight: Unseated at first fence on chase/handicap debut in December and also made mistakes when fourth of seven at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) last month, beaten just over 13l; he needs a bigger run today but this 8yo has raced only five times and is in top hands; no surprise to see a sizeable step forward.

runners.comment: Tailed off on h'cap debut when bidding for hat-trick; could leave that behind if settling
runners.name: Ice In The Veins
runners.spotlight: Won two novice hurdles in November (2m3f/2m, good); tailed off on recent handicap debut at Kempton (2m, good to soft), following a wind op, but could leave that performance behind if settling better; unraced on soft.

runners.comment: Only sixth on Newbury h'cap debut but it may well have been a warm race; retains potential
runners.name: Sir Hobnob
runners.spotlight: Merely sixth, beaten 15l, on last month's handicap debut at Newbury (2m, good to soft); however, it may well have been a warm race and prior to that he went close in a novice at Leicester (1m7f, soft); retains potential.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Du Fosse Blanc
runners.comment: Tailed off at Kempton recently but may have needed the run and is not written off
runners.name: Soleil dArizona
runners.spotlight: Headstrong mare who won three times between last April-September (1m7f/2m, good); tailed off at Kempton (2m, good to soft) recently following a break but may have needed the outing; showed promise on soft ground in France; not written off.

runners.comment: Encouraging 3rd on hurdle debut; two lesser runs since but makes h'cap debut after wind op
runners.name: Phineas Bunce
runners.spotlight: Promise in bumpers (soft/good) before encouraging third on hurdle debut at Fontwell (2m1f, good to soft) in November; two lesser runs have followed but he now goes handicapping following wind surgery and it will be no surprise if he plays a leading role for his top trainer (who saddles three).

runners.comment: Runner-up on both hurdle starts; could benefit from drop back in trip on handicap debut
runners.name: Diamonds Galore
runners.owner: Turf Club 2024 & The Burling Family Ltd
runners.spotlight: Placed in two bumpers (including on soft) and runner-up on both hurdle starts (2m/2m5f, good/good to soft), here most recently; she could benefit from the drop back in trip on handicap debut and is one to consider.

runners.comment: Flat winner who has made the frame on both hurdle starts; his opening mark looks workable
runners.name: Sense Of Reason
runners.spotlight: Flat winner (1m2f, AW) who has made the frame at 66-1 this winter on his first two hurdle starts (2m, soft); his opening mark looks workable and he's open to further improvement in this code; chance.

runners.comment: 4yo who did it easily at Huntingdon last time and a 9lb rise may not stop him
runners.name: Westlain
runners.spotlight: Won juvenile hurdle at Fontwell (2m1f, good to soft) in November and returned to form to win handicap against older horses at Huntingdon (2m, soft) a fortnight ago; did it easily last time and a 9lb rise may not stop him.

runners.comment: May have needed the run on handicap debut but needs to be entirely different proposition
runners.name: Regal Cavalier
runners.owner: Quids In Messers Guthrie Bowen & Prosser
runners.spotlight: French Flat winner (soft) who showed promise in C&D novice hurdle (good to soft) last April; he may have needed the run when pulled up at 28-1 on handicap debut at Hereford (2m, soft) in December but he needs to be an entirely different proposition today.

16:35.race_name: Farm And Garden Machinery Ltd Overgrown Hedges Novices' Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Dropped to 2m1f from 2m4f he ran better to be beaten about 12l at Market Rasen
runners.name: Icare Colombe
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 8yo; dropped to 2m1f from 2m4f he ran better to be beaten about 12l at Market Rasen (2m1f, soft) a month ago; down 3lb with cheekpieces fitted and more appealing than a good many.

runners.comment: Last to complete on chase debut, albeit under 7l off the winner
runners.name: Count Adhemar
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced; led early and jumped well on chase debut at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft) but was last to complete, albeit under 7l off the winner; could build on that.

runners.comment: Tailed off in all his runs for Evan Williams and he's not bred for chasing; reservations
runners.name: Model Approach
runners.spotlight: Won two juvenile hurdles for Adrian Keatley in 2024 (blinkered); tailed off in all his runs for Evan Williams and he's not bred for chasing; reservations.

runners.comment: Gave it a fair go from the front last time at Taunton (2m2f, heavy); should build on that
runners.name: Falco Des Pins
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 6yo; had wind surgery in between his two runs over fences and gave it a fair go from the front last time at Taunton (2m2f, heavy); should build on that and be involved in a race of this nature; down 2lb and in trip.

runners.comment: 17-race maiden with a Flat background and hard to know what she'll make of fences
runners.name: Make Sunshine
runners.spotlight: Well in on some of her hurdle form but she's a 17-race maiden with a Flat background, so hard to know what she'll make of fences.

runners.comment: Has finished tailed off in two handicap chases, on good and heavy ground
runners.name: OGradys Hill
runners.spotlight: Point winner who was runner-up in a bumper and two maiden hurdles; however, has finished tailed off in two handicap chases, on good and heavy ground; tried cheekpieces last time.

runners.comment: Behind early and never involved in this new headgear combination at Warwick last time
runners.name: Blackijo Dagrostis
runners.spotlight: 0-8 in points and ten defeats under rules divided between hurdles and fences; behind early and never involved in this new headgear combination at Warwick last time (2m, good to soft).

runners.comment: 0-8 over hurdles and twice disappointing since a third of six at Newton Abbot in September
runners.name: Jacksons Bay
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles and twice disappointing since a third of six at Newton Abbot in September (2m1f, good to soft); wouldn't be the obvious answer on this switch to fences.

runners.comment: Best form on latest start (2m4f handicap on soft); needs extra but heading the right way
runners.name: Fresh Kicks
runners.spotlight: Easy winner at 1-3 in a maiden at Plumpton (2m4f, soft) in December; didn't see out the extended 2m7f on handicap debut next time and his fourth at Windsor (2m4f, soft; bumped before two out) on latest was better; still needs extra but he's heading the right way.

runners.comment: Has improved; needs further progress on this handicap debut, but these are early days
runners.name: Name Me Nicely
runners.spotlight: Close up when unseating at the last in a small field at Doncaster on penultimate start and confirmed his improvement when 14l fourth of 13 over that same extended 2m3f last month (soft; 28-1); needs further progress on this handicap debut, but these are early days and it may be forthcoming.

runners.comment: Won three in a row last season; ran poorly at Warwick on latest start, ten weeks ago
runners.name: Lord Of All Saints
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row last season (2m3f-2m4f, good to soft/soft); scoped dirty after final race last term and, although not disgraced on reappearance, he ran poorly at Warwick on latest start; off ten weeks and needs a revival.

runners.breeder: Philippe Decouz & Scea Du Bas Bugey
runners.comment: 0-8 on Flat in France; 2nd all three hurdle starts; has potential on handicap hurdle debut
runners.name: Manigod
runners.spotlight: 0-8 on Flat in France; runner-up at Plumpton (2m5f) on his first two starts for new stable and same again at Fontwell (2m3f, soft) on his third hurdling attempt; brings potential to this handicap hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Not so good last time (2m, soft); absent 96 days since but needs a second look
runners.name: The Expensive One
runners.spotlight: Won at Stratford (2m2f, good) on handicap debut; pulled up at Cheltenham (2m4f) later in October after a mistake three out caused the saddle to slip and jockey to lose irons; he disputed the lead at the time of that mishap (albeit after earlier jumping issues as well) but did not run so well there in November (2m, soft); absent 96 days since but needs a second look.

runners.comment: Back hurdling on a competitive mark but with more to prove on worse than good to soft
runners.name: DJo Dela Barriere
runners.spotlight: Won a 3m handicap hurdle at Ffos Las (good) before returning to fences at Ludlow (3m, good) later in October where he finished alone after being left in isolation three out; tailed off in a Hereford chase on latest start and absent 107 days since; back hurdling on a competitive mark but with more to prove on worse than good to soft.

runners.comment: Tailed off on both outings in 2026, on latest when dropped back to 2m5f
runners.name: Spitalfield
runners.spotlight: Sole win in May 2024, with several good efforts over staying trips last year but he's been tailed off on both outings in 2026, on latest when dropped back to 2m5f; others therefore look more solid.

runners.comment: Stamina not proven and ground worse than good to soft looks a problem
runners.name: Broderick
runners.spotlight: Had a solid spell at maiden/novice level last winter but form dipped in the spring and he was well beaten last month after an eight-month break; stamina not proven and ground worse than good to soft looks a problem.

14:20.race_name: Download The At The Races App Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Improved when 2nd on chase debut in November; more to come and new trip is a positive
runners.name: Bank On Frank
runners.spotlight: Point runner-up for Tom Ellis; stepped up on his hurdles form when a rallying second at Fontwell (about 2m5f, good to soft) on his chase debut in November; subsequent absence is a small concern but there's likely more to come from him, with this extra distance a positive.

runners.comment: 1-34 and hasn't been at his best in three starts this term; not the percentage call
runners.name: Good Work
runners.spotlight: 1-34 and he hasn't been at his best in three starts this term; career-low mark but he isn't the percentage call.

runners.comment: Back on last winning mark but last two efforts uninspiring; needs a revival
runners.name: Mixedwave
runners.spotlight: Scored for the fifth time over fences when taking a Wetherby handicap (3m, good) in March; back down to that mark but his last two efforts have been uninspiring; needs a revival but that's not out of the question.

runners.comment: Bit to prove in this sphere but first-time cheekpieces may help and he's on a handy mark
runners.name: Streamsforth Lad
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden who was pulled up on chase debut last February and unseated mid-race when back over fences two months ago; something to prove in this sphere but perhaps the first-time cheekpieces will help and he's on a handy mark on his November hurdle form; possible contender.

runners.comment: Big recent hurdles defeat but nicely handicapped now; Sean Bowen (4-5 for yard) is booked
runners.name: Hot Rod Lincoln
runners.spotlight: Beaten a whopping 127l when just 7-2 for Lingfield handicap hurdle (2m7f, heavy; first-time tongue-tie) 13 days ago; that's an obvious concern but maybe the added headgear backfired and he won off just 1lb lower at Uttoxeter (3m, soft) on his last chase start for Simon Hodgson about a year ago; Sean Bowen (4-5 for this yard) is an interesting jockey booking.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish 14-race maiden under rules who suffered 4 heavy defeats over fences for this yard
runners.name: Givehimthehonour
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 14-race maiden under rules who has suffered four heavy defeats over fences for this yard, twice in a tongue-tie and once in cheekpieces; no aids today, which might be a straw to cling to, but he has a lot to prove.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Metairie
runners.comment: 3-4 over C&D; respectable second 184 days ago; has form after a break and market helpful
runners.name: Prince Cleni
runners.spotlight: 3-20 over fences but the wins have all come over this C&D (good and soft); he wasn't completely done with when taking a fairly dramatic fall two out at Worcester in June and it was a respectable second over a marathon trip at Stratford (good to firm) in August when last seen; has form after a break and the market should shine a light on his readiness for this.

14:55.race_name: Book The Bistro In Sherwood Restaurant Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Exors Of The Late Michael Lysaght
runners.comment: Good 2nd (2m4f, heavy) on yard debut in December; pulled up latest but can't be ruled out
runners.name: Doyouknowwhatimean
runners.spotlight: Finished fourth in this last year prior to winning twice at around 2m on good ground for Dan Skelton in the spring; good start for this yard when second at Uttoxeter (2m4f, heavy) in December; pulled up at Wetherby next time but that was a better race than this; can't be ruled out.

runners.comment: Poor in 2 starts this term and has a question to answer at present; market support a help
runners.name: Get Up Mush
runners.spotlight: Switch to fences and handicaps did the trick when he won three of his five starts in 2024; he hasn't got back to that level in two outings this term and has a question to answer at present; of interest only with market support.

runners.comment: Runner-up in 2 Irish points; unseated on h'cap/chase debut but unexposed and can do better
runners.name: Gaelic Rambler
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two Irish points; had wind surgery prior to beating a total of two finishers when placed in a pair of Chepstow maiden hurdles (about 3m, good) last spring; looked to be losing the argument when unseating three out on his handicap/chase debut at Wincanton (3m1f, soft) last month but he's unexposed and should come on for that first start in 269 days; drops in trip and likely has more to offer.

runners.breeder: S Shiel D Savage & T Nolan
runners.comment: In-form chaser who should be fine back down in trip; leading contender
runners.name: He Knows Better
runners.owner: Mrs Isobel Webb & Mrs Julie Fowler
runners.spotlight: Fontwell maiden hurdle winner in May 2024 who's been competitive since handicapping over fences this term, bang there when coming down two out at Haydock (2m4f) in December before finishing runner-up in staying chases at Huntingdon and Warwick (all good to soft); drop back in trip probably no bother and he's a firm contender once more.

runners.comment: Third in this last year and solid 2nd on penultimate start; holds each-way claims again
runners.name: William Cody
runners.spotlight: Third in this last year; four-time chase winner (all at about this trip) but hasn't scored since November 2024; close second at Catterick (2m3f, good) on penultimate start but lesser efforts either side of that; remains below his last winning mark and holds each-way claims again.

runners.comment: One blip in four starts for the yard; solid third last time; tongue-tie goes on; respected
runners.name: Disguisedlimit
runners.spotlight: Just one blip in four starts for this yard and it was a solid effort when third of 11 at Ayr (about 2m, soft) three weeks ago; previously twice a runner-up over this sort of trip and now the tongue-tie goes on; respected.

runners.comment: Poor in 2 starts following year's absence and had an irregular heartbeat last time; risky
runners.name: Noche Negra
runners.spotlight: Jumped well when scoring on his stable debut (2m4f, soft) in late 2024 but he hasn't recaptured that form in two runs following a year's absence, latterly when found to have an irregular heartbeat back at Warwick last month; risky at present.

runners.comment: Hasn't got going in h'cap chases but has been attracting support; can probably do better
runners.name: Rule Me In
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner here (2m, good to soft) about a year ago; hasn't got going in handicap chases so far but he attracted good support on his penultimate start and didn't go unbacked last time either; unexposed and it will be interesting to see if his supporters come back for more.

15:25.race_name: Book Your Event At Southwell Racecourse Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB)

runners.breeder: S C E A De LAubay & Guillaume Cousin
runners.comment: Cost £95,000 after March's winning debut; player under a penalty on first go for this yard
runners.name: Brecharnon
runners.spotlight: Quite a lively 9-1 shot when he went in at the first time of asking for Mac Gayveur's trainer Tom Weston at Chepstow (good) last March; picked up for £95,000 the following month and has joined a top stable; contender under a penalty on this reappearance.

runners.comment: 18-1 and beaten an awfully long way on his debut at Hereford (soft) last month
runners.name: Arizona Moon
runners.spotlight: 18-1 and beaten an awfully long way on his debut at Hereford (soft) last month; best to look elsewhere.

runners.comment: 2nd in Irish point in March; no show in Listed bumper in November; tongue-tie goes on
runners.name: Eclat De Marvel
runners.spotlight: Favourite when second of 13 in Irish point (3m, good to yielding) in March; first and third have scored under rules this term but no immediate promise from this one when tailed off in a Listed Cheltenham bumper (soft; 9-1) in November; the fact he started off there is interesting, though, and he's in good hands; tongue-tie goes on.

runners.comment: Off the mark in third Irish point; bought for £62,000 six days later; market can guide
runners.name: Ka Mate Du Brivet
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in his third Irish point when scoring in November and he was bought for £62,000 six days later; yard has plenty of success in this sphere; market can guide.

runners.comment: £65,000 3yo; plenty of hope in pedigree and in-form yard can have winners in this sphere
runners.name: Kappa Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: £65,000 3yo by Kapgarde; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Martha Willow (bumper) and Gamaline (French 2m hurdle); dam 1m4f-1m7f AQPS Flat and useful Irish 2m hurdle winner, half-sister to 12.5f and 14.5f AQPS Flat and smart 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Trifolium; plenty of hope in that pedigree and in-form yard can have winners in this sphere.

runners.comment: 80-1 and could beat only two home at Wetherby (soft) in December; much more is needed
runners.name: Lou Des Bordes
runners.owner: Prof Alyn Morice & Miss Caroline Nowell
runners.spotlight: 80-1 and could beat only two home at Wetherby (soft) in December; much more is needed.

runners.comment: Odds-on, won Irish point debut in March; bought for £135,000 four days later; interesting
runners.name: Midnight Jukebox
runners.spotlight: Odds-on for soft-ground Irish point debut in March and won from a subsequently useful sort under rules in gritty fashion; bought for £135,000 four days later and has joined a yard that takes bumpers seriously; has to be of interest.

runners.comment: Favourite when winning Irish point in March; cost £100,000 the following month; respected
runners.name: Smokehouse
runners.spotlight: 5-2 favourite when beating four other finishers in Irish point (3m, good to yielding) last March and was secured for £100,000 the following month; yard is 6-24 in bumpers this term and this rules debutant commands respect.

runners.comment: By Mondialiste; family of According To Pete; yard 0-3 in bumpers this term
runners.name: Little Ruby
runners.spotlight: By Mondialiste; first foal; dam 1m6f/2m winner (RPR 62), half-sister to useful bumper/2m4f-3m1f hurdle winner Black Ivory, out of unraced half-sister to smart bumper and 2m1f-3m1f hurdle/chase winner According To Pete; yard can have winners in this sphere but 0-3 in bumpers this term.

runners.comment: Half-brother to 5 winners; yard no stranger to success in bumpers; market check essential
runners.name: Mac Gayveur
runners.spotlight: Twelfth foal; King Edward half-brother to winners Aniknam (bumper/2m-3m3f hurdle), Citrus (2m hurdle), Veilleur (2m5f chase), Grooveur (2m5f hurdle) and Qui Est Qui (1m4f AQPS Flat); dam unraced sister to 1m3f AQPS Flat and 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Dominateur; yard no stranger to success in this sphere; market check essential.

runners.comment: Ulysses gelding with mixed pedigree; stable is 0-10 in bumpers this season
runners.name: Pluto Star
runners.spotlight: Ulysses gelding; second foal; dam 1m3f-1m5f Flat (RPR 76) and 2m hurdle winner, half-sister to winners Crossford (7f-1m including 2yo/HK), So Suave (Ire/US/Canada 7f-8.5f including 2yo) and Star Story (1m4f); stable has only the occasional bumper winner and is 0-10 in them this season.

runners.comment: 58,000euros 3yo with a useful pedigree; yard is 9-79 in bumpers over the last five seasons
runners.name: Sea Tempest
runners.spotlight: By Affinisea; 58,000euros 3yo; sixth foal; brother to point and useful 2m4f/2m7f chase winner Romeo Magico, half-brother to bumper and useful 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Ruaille Buaille; dam unraced sister to high-class 2m-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Hidden Cyclone; yard is 9-79 in bumpers over the last five seasons; market helpful on his debut.

15:55.race_name: Gleeds Data Center Derby Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 5-1 and third in sole Irish point (3m, soft) in May 2024; had wind surgery; rules debut
runners.name: Always Stronger
runners.spotlight: 5-1 and kept on for third in May 2024 in his sole Irish point (3m, soft); had wind surgery in September; market may help on this rules debut.

runners.comment: Promise on hurdles debut; tall task in G2 latest; drops in class and trip; tongue-tie on
runners.name: Big Cadillac
runners.spotlight: Won in February 2024 in his only Irish point (3m) and turned over a talented odds-on rival in Chepstow bumper (2m, also heavy) just over a year ago; shaped with some promise when sixth in a Ffos Las maiden (2m4f, soft) on hurdles debut in October and no disgrace when well held in Cheltenham Grade 2 novice (3m, good to soft) in December; drops in class and trip with tongue-tie added; leading contender.

runners.comment: Beaten miles in two maiden hurdles around this trip at Hereford and Plumpton; unlikely
runners.name: Blazing Saint
runners.spotlight: Beaten miles in two maiden hurdles at about this trip at Hereford and Plumpton; unlikely to make an impact this time either.

runners.comment: 13-2 from 12-1 on debut but never threatened; in top hands and likely capable of better
runners.name: Blue Run
runners.spotlight: 13-2 from 12-1 but never threatened from the rear on his debut at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft) in December; cost 170,000euros as a 3yo and he's in top hands, however, so likely capable of better.

runners.comment: 25-1 and eighth in Warwick bumper 300 days ago; market helpful on stable/hurdling debut
runners.name: Double Tiger
runners.spotlight: Trained by his owner when 25-1 (from 14s) and eighth in a Warwick bumper 300 days ago; market helpful on this stable/hurdling debut.

runners.comment: Went off too quickly last time but previous handicap third gives him claims
runners.name: Escortkheops
runners.spotlight: Ran himself into the ground over 2m at Huntingdon (soft) a fortnight ago but previously finished a solid third of 14 in Catterick handicap (about 2m3f, good) in December; that better form gives him claims.

runners.comment: Good family but can only be watched after pulling up on debut a fortnight ago
runners.name: Felix Maximus
runners.spotlight: Tongue tied for debut when he stopped quickly and was pulled up before the home turn at Lingfield (2m, heavy; 14-1) a fortnight ago; comes from a good family but can only be watched after that debut.

runners.comment: Experienced pointer who is 2-16 in that sphere but tailed off at Horseheath last month
runners.name: Imnottalkingtoyou
runners.spotlight: Experienced pointer who is 2-16 in that sphere but finished tailed off at Horseheath last month; will be of more interest once handicapped; stable/hurdling debut.

runners.comment: 66-1 when pulled up in a Doncaster novice (about 2m3f, good) in late December
runners.name: Its Party Time
runners.spotlight: Every chance when running out at the last in his second Irish point but 66-1 when pulled up in Doncaster novice (about 2m3f, good) in late December; others more likely.

runners.comment: 45,000euros 3yo by Dink; yard among the winners; check the market for this debut
runners.name: Jonny Setaside
runners.spotlight: 45,000euros 3yo by Dink; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Hinterland (high-class 2m hurdle/chase) and Lofte Place (French 2m1f/2m2f hurdle/chase, dam of useful and prolific winning French jumpers Placement and Thrilling); yard won two races at the last meeting here, including a maiden hurdle; market helpful on this debut.

runners.comment: Beaten a combined 73l on his last two starts; needs this fourth run for a mark
runners.name: Noble George
runners.spotlight: Beaten a combined 73l on last two starts; captured the stewards' attention at Newcastle on first occasion; needs this fourth run for a mark.

runners.comment: Improved when close second (2m, heavy) in December; step up in trip a positive; contender
runners.name: Pertemps
runners.spotlight: Close second at Uttoxeter (heavy) in December but found a sharper test at Huntingdon (also 2m, soft) against him when a distant third last month; step up in trip looks a positive; firmly in the picture with Sean Bowen up.

runners.comment: 33-1 and pulled up in good Leicester novice (about 2m4f, heavy) on rules debut last month
runners.name: Tombereau
runners.spotlight: Displayed inexperience at some hurdles when 33-1 and pulled up in good Leicester novice (about 2m4f, heavy) on his rules debut last month; others have more pressing claims.

runners.comment: Solid on last three starts without progressing; step up in trip is a help, though; player
runners.name: Zamek
runners.spotlight: Second on hurdling/stable debut (good to soft) in November but didn't really progress on his next two starts at Kempton (good) and back at Lingfield (also 2m, soft), after which he had wind surgery; this step up in trip should help, however, and he's a player despite Sean Bowen siding with Pertemps.

16:25.race_name: Ladies Day Sunday 16th August Handicap Hurdle

runners.breeder: B Caron B Caron & Mme V Caron
runners.comment: Easily won three-runner military riders' race at Wincanton last time; high on the list
runners.name: Hidor De Bersy
runners.spotlight: 9yo who has been lightly raced in recent years; returned from an absence with 11l second at Plumpton (2m4f, good) in November under Vicki Sollitt, then easily won three-runner military riders' race at Wincanton (2m4f, good to soft); won on soft ground earlier in his career; high on the list.

runners.comment: Step back in right direction at Taunton last time and could build on that now handicapping
runners.name: Jaffa Cake
runners.spotlight: All five starts on good/good to soft ground; disappointing in the main since finishing second in a Doncaster bumper on debut last March but took step back in right direction when 22l fourth in maiden hurdle at Taunton last month; he could build on that now up in trip on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Yet to threaten over hurdles but has far more realistic claims in this first handicap
runners.name: Kastellion
runners.spotlight: Point runner-up (3m, yielding) who has been unable to threaten across his three hurdle runs (2m3f/2m4f, good to soft/soft) but has shown ability and has far more realistic claims in this first handicap; not ruled out.

runners.breeder: Ecurie Smart Elevage Chevaux De Courses
runners.comment: Chiefly in good form over fences in autumn; 0-11 over hurdles but respected nevertheless
runners.name: Heaven Smart
runners.spotlight: In good form over fences in the autumn, bar a blip at Perth in October; 0-11 over hurdles but twice finished second in this sphere and often runs well after a break; entitled to respect.

runners.comment: Went close on handicap debut last April but four lesser performances have followed
runners.name: Caramelo Rapido
runners.spotlight: Went close on handicap debut at Carlisle (2m1f, good) last April and now 5lb lower, but four lesser performances have followed (2m3f/2m4f, good-soft) and he needs to turn things around.

runners.comment: One to watch in betting now up in trip in second handicap but big step forward necessary
runners.name: In The Purple
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 5yo who is in good hands and is one to watch in the betting now up in trip on second handicap start; however, he was again well beaten when 33-1 at Uttoxeter (2m, good to soft) in his first handicap.

runners.comment: Some good form in November/December but two lacklustre efforts have followed
runners.name: Farmer Jimmy
runners.owner: J Scarrow I Barker & S Turner
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Wetherby (3m, soft) in November and ran pretty well when fourth of 12 at Catterick (3m1f, good to soft) next time; of interest on those performances but two lacklustre efforts have followed.

runners.comment: Yet to finish better than fifth but pedigree indicates this step up in trip is a good move
runners.name: Ever Ready
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who is yet to finish better than fifth and was beaten about 12l when sixth of nine on last month's handicap debut at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft); however, her useful pedigree indicates this step up in trip will be a good move and she may well be in the shake-up.

runners.comment: Made the frame in all three bumpers but soundly beaten on all six hurdle starts
runners.name: Snapaudaciaheros
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in all three bumpers but soundly beaten on all six hurdle starts, most recently 21l fifth of ten in C&D handicap (good to soft); improvement is needed in a first-time tongue-tie.

runners.breeder: Cte Michel De Gigou & F Thomas De Gigou
runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo; one to watch in market but he's not got competitive in his three h'caps
runners.name: Ker dOudairies
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who is one to watch in the market but he's failed to get competitive in his three handicaps; needs something extra.

runners.comment: Showed little under rules in 2023-24 but won a point last March; has basement opening mark
runners.name: Huckleberry Sting
runners.spotlight: Didn't achieve much for Dan Skelton in 2023-24 at the start of his career but won a British maiden point by 5l last March (3m, good to soft) when last seen; returns with yard enjoying a good February and he has a basement mark for his handicap debut; firmly in calculations.

runners.comment: Struggled last May-August in her first four handicaps and 8lb wrong at the weights today
runners.name: Sweet Serene
runners.spotlight: Struggled last May-August in her first four handicaps and 8lb wrong at the weights today; a transformation is needed following wind surgery.

16:55.race_name: Golf And Gallop Package Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Won Catterick chase for second time latest; bids to repeat 2025 win in this; big chance
runners.name: Asa
runners.spotlight: Resurgent mare who is on a familiar path; won the same Catterick handicap chase (3m1f, soft) last week that she did a year ago; now bids to repeat her 2025 success in this race (good to soft; by 27l no less); same mark as last week (2lb well in) and big chance history repeats itself.

runners.comment: Has not got going for this yard and hard to suggest until showing something
runners.name: Bluella Bresil
runners.spotlight: Achieved little since her return last month (stable/handicap debut) from a lengthy absence, including when last of six finishers at Plumpton nine days ago; goes up in trip and while things can only get better, she's hard to suggest until showing something.

runners.comment: Good run of form came to an abrupt halt last time; needs to bounce back
runners.name: Princesse Milania
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Olly Murphy with clear win at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft) in October and followed up at Wetherby (about 2m5f, good) for new stable a few days later; also ran well when third on next two outings but took a big backward step off this mark at Market Rasen last time; needs to put that behind her.

runners.comment: Won this in 2024; return to hurdling, cheekpieces and this C&D are reasons to be positive
runners.name: Innisfree Lass
runners.spotlight: Won this is 2024 (first-time cheekpieces), followed up over C&D (also heavy) seven weeks later and beaten just a neck on only other start here; has been chasing since without success and finished a long way off Asa at Catterick last week (first-time blinkers) but returning cheekpieces, hurdling and this C&D are all reasons to be positive.

runners.comment: Prolific mare who made it 6-11 for this yard when scoring last time; leading claims
runners.name: Queen Of Steel
runners.spotlight: Got on a roll last spring having joined this yard, winning at Ffos Las and Wetherby (2m4f/3m, good; cheekpieces) before clinching a Flat-race hat-trick at staying trips; brought her stable record to 6-11 when scoring at Leicester (about 2m4f, heavy) one month ago and holds leading claims once again.

runners.comment: No impact in sole handicap and fell at the first last time; others much more solid
runners.name: Feeling Frisky
runners.spotlight: Distant third at Worcester (2m, good) in September probably the best of her qualifying runs; no impact when 33-1 for a Hereford handicap in October and came down at the first when back in maiden company a fortnight ago; it's still relatively early days but others are far more solid.

runners.comment: Inconsistent but return to hurdling and cheekpieces might help; chance if on a going day
runners.name: Lady Harriett
runners.spotlight: First-time cheekpieces did the trick when she won at Ffos Las in November 2024 and she matched that form when third of 14 here (also about 2m4f, good to soft) last February; inconsistent and generally struggling since and pulled up after a bad mistake when blinkered for chase debut last time; handy mark, however, and the return to hurdles and cheekpieces might help.

17:30.race_name: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (Rider Restricted Race) (London Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: 7f AW win for Alice Haynes last summer; quiet afterwards but not ruled out on stable debut
runners.name: Sudbury Hill
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f maiden at Newcastle for Alice Haynes last summer but failed to progress in four further runs; new stable quick to step him up in trip and he's of interest on the Newcastle run.

runners.comment: 0-5 for former yard; sold 40,000gns in October and gelded; down in class for his return
runners.name: Dryburgh
runners.spotlight: 0-5 for Jane Chapple-Hyam, showing his best form when third of seven in a Chester novice last August (7.6f, good to firm); changed hands for 40,000gns in October and gelded; drops in class but this looks warm for the grade.

runners.comment: 2-2 since visored and handicapping; 5lb well in under a penalty; the one to beat
runners.name: Silver State
runners.spotlight: 2-2 since moving into handicaps and fitted with a visor, readily seeing off nine rivals at Wolverhampton before winning by a wide-margin at Newcastle on Saturday; 5lb well in under a penalty and he can take the step up in class in his stride.

runners.comment: Two solid efforts for new yard this year; needs more now up to 1m for her handicap debut
runners.name: Loma Express
runners.spotlight: Good efforts at Lingfield in two runs for her new stable this year; steps up to 1m for her handicap debut but it will need to prompt improvement if she is to defy this mark.

runners.comment: Looks a likely improver in handicaps this year; gelded since last run; headgear off today
runners.name: Warning Symbol
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to connections' smart Wimbledon Hawkeye; promise amidst inexperience in his three runs as a 2yo; gelded following latest Chelmsford third (7f); looks a likely improver now handicapping over a mile; cheekpieces worn last time are now dispensed with.

runners.comment: Chasing hat-trick after two Newcastle wins (7f/1m); up 4lb but going the right way; solid
runners.name: Maria Da Silva
runners.spotlight: Improving with experience, getting off the mark at Newcastle (7f) last month and following up in a 1m handicap back there 12 days ago; 4lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run.

runners.comment: Class 6 nursery win last summer; gelded after two lesser efforts; personal best needed
runners.name: Port Darwin
runners.spotlight: 1m turf win last August (Class 6); not so good in Class 5 events twice in September; gelded since latest; improvement needed back from a break.

runners.comment: 4th of 7 over C&D on handicap debut three weeks ago; up in class with improvement needed
runners.name: Quick Turn
runners.spotlight: Fourth of seven, beaten 4.75l, on stable/handicap debut over C&D three weeks ago; more will be needed in this higher grade but he is unexposed.

18:00.race_name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Rider Restricted Race)

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and on a handy mark; drop into Class 5 could revive his fortunes
runners.name: King Of Fury
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late P R Blackett
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; two of his three wins have come over C&D and he is now 1lb lower than for the latest of them; not at best in two runs here this winter but this represents a drop in class.

runners.comment: C&D winner; close third here when last seen in November; another big run expected
runners.name: Atmosphere
runners.spotlight: The winner of three of his 11 starts, the latest over C&D in October off 4lb lower (visored first time); close up in third here the following month; should make a bold bid back from a break.

runners.comment: 1m win at Chelmsford in October was followed by three lesser runs; headgear off today
runners.name: Beauty By My Side
runners.spotlight: Returned to form in first-time cheekpieces when winning a 1m handicap at Chelmsford last October; three modest efforts followed and the headgear is now dispensed with.

runners.comment: Won this race last year off 3lb higher; mixed bag afterwards; new headgear for return
runners.name: Zoffandia
runners.spotlight: Won the corresponding race 12 months ago off a 3lb higher mark; mixed bag since but he ended 2025 with a good third here in October; returns from a break with new headgear tried; one to consider.

runners.comment: Generally struggled last year but returns from a break off a reduced mark; others safer
runners.name: Eazy On The Eye
runners.spotlight: Won twice at Wolverhampton as a 2yo; generally struggled in 2025 but she has dropped in the weights and returns to action off a reduced mark; others look safer.

runners.comment: Good 3rd at Newcastle last month; sold 12,000gns since; new yard leaves headgear off
runners.name: Midnights Dream
runners.spotlight: Two wins for Roger Varian last year, over 7f here and 1m at Leicester; solid third at Newcastle 18 days ago, after which he changed hands for 12,000gns; blinkers absent on stable debut.

runners.comment: Yet to win over 1m but does stay the trip; third on last two starts; should go well again
runners.name: Tadreeb
runners.spotlight: All wins have come over 7f but he is fully effective at this trip; third in Lingfield handicaps on his last two starts; should remain competitive.

runners.breeder: Genesis Green Stud & Lady Juliet Tadgell
runners.comment: 7f course winner; running okay in handicaps this winter; change of headgear today
runners.name: Emery Down
runners.spotlight: Her maiden win came over 7f here last May; struggled initially in handicaps but she has been more competitive this winter; new headgear given a spin this time.

runners.comment: 0-6 but has shown promise in handicaps; down in weights and may do better yet
runners.name: Baloos Blues
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but he has shown promise in handicaps over 7f and 1m; down in the weights and could still have a bigger run in him.

runners.breeder: Arrow Farm & Stud/Miss A Gibson Fleming
runners.comment: C&D winner; dangerous mark if the return of cheekpieces has the desired effect
runners.name: Beauty Generation
runners.spotlight: C&D winner off 4lb higher when trained by Marco Botti; quiet in Ireland last year and never a threat on his stable debut six weeks ago; return of cheekpieces could give him a lift and he is an interesting contender.

runners.breeder: Brook Stud Bloodstock & W A Tinkler
runners.comment: Struggled since handicapping, including back from a break at Chelmsford last month
runners.name: Lady Justice
runners.owner: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden at Epsom (7f, good to soft) on her debut in July 2024 but she never threatened in three starts last year and last month's Chelmsford return didn't point to a revival either.

18:30.race_name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (Rider Restricted Race)

runners.comment: Easy win (1m) ten days ago but only 4th under a penalty on Saturday; respected back at 7f
runners.name: Whos On First
runners.spotlight: Dominant display when making all in a 1m handicap at Chelmsford ten days ago but turned over off this mark at Lingfield on Saturday; dropping in trip shouldn't hurt and he's more appealing than many.

runners.comment: Promise over C&D on second start; rates a likely improver now handicapping
runners.name: Seapearl
runners.spotlight: Down the field in her three runs this year, all over 7f, but she caught the eye over C&D on her second start, racing in last but making some headway in the closing stages (ran the fastest final furlong sectional despite meeting a bit of trouble); could leave that form behind her now handicapping.

runners.comment: Improvement essential but stepping up in trip should be beneficial judged on pedigree
runners.name: Black Rock Beauty
runners.spotlight: Never in the hunt on his handicap debut at Wolverhampton five weeks ago; now steps up in distance and it could spark some improvement.

runners.comment: Poor form in three sprint runs in late 2025; bred to do much better at some point
runners.name: Zoustellar
runners.spotlight: Down the field in three sprint runs in late 2025; not obviously well treated for her handicap debut but she is bred to be much better than this level and a big step forward would be no surprise.

runners.comment: Low-level form over 5f as a 2yo; can do better this year but progress is essential
runners.name: Amakhala
runners.spotlight: Only beat two rivals home in his three 2yo starts (all at 5f); gelded prior to his reappearance and he is bred to stay this far; can do better this year but he needs to.

runners.comment: Runner-up in two 7f handicaps this month; 3lb higher today but not fully exposed
runners.name: Crimson Rambler
runners.spotlight: Didn't achieve much as a 2yo but he has improved for the switch to 7f handicaps this month, finishing second at Wolverhampton and Southwell; 3lb higher today but not fully exposed just yet.

runners.comment: No real improvement for handicapping this year; down in weights but more is required
runners.name: Frankali
runners.spotlight: No significant improvement for the switch to Class 6 handicaps this year; edging down the weights but a career best is required to win.

runners.comment: Promise on nursery debut but couldn't build on it next time; now steps up in trip
runners.name: Magnificent Mel
runners.spotlight: Penultimate third at Chelmsford (6f) was an encouraging run but she failed to build on it at Southwell on New Year's Day; steps up in trip with a point to prove.

19:00.race_name: Set Your Limits With Unibet Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (Rider Restricted Race) (GBB)

runners.comment: Encouraging debut when third at Lingfield four weeks ago (7f); open to improvement
runners.name: Portman Blue
runners.spotlight: Unconsidered 66-1 shot on his belated debut at Lingfield four weeks ago (7f) but he made a pleasing start to his career, slowly away but making up ground against the far rail in the home straight, eventually beaten 3l into third; open to improvement but it will likely be needed if he is to beat the 3yos.

runners.comment: Solid efforts over 6f on turf last summer; bred for 7f; leading claims with more to come
runners.name: Comic Hero
runners.spotlight: Green on last summer's debut but he stepped forward when a close third at Salisbury in June (6f, good to firm); similar form when beaten a nose at Newbury one month later; absent since (has been gelded) but he is bred to stay 7f and remains capable of better; looks the one to beat.

runners.comment: Good debut at Chelmsford (7f) but lesser run over 1m next time; has hung left so track a ?
runners.name: Variety Act
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck when second of 13 at Chelmsford on his debut in November (7f); disappointing third when odds-on for a 1m maiden back at Chelmsford five weeks ago; still has time to do better but he has hung left in both starts and going right-handed is a potential issue.

runners.breeder: Mickley Stud Ltd & Tim & Miranda Johnson
runners.comment: 20,000gns half-sister to a 1m2f winner in France; market instructive on debut
runners.name: Nefyn Queen
runners.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to French 1m2f winner Belsiana (RPR 80); dam unraced sister to 6f 2yo winner Turbo Spirit, half-sister to 1m2f AW Group 3 winner Robin Hoods Bay; market instructive on debut.

runners.comment: Promise in two 7f runs this winter but needs a good step forward to trouble the principals
runners.name: Pink Diamond Girl
runners.spotlight: Signs of ability in two 7f AW runs this winter but she will need to raise her game a couple of notches to trouble the principals.

runners.comment: Dam a useful middle-distance winner from a good family; may be a longer-term prospect
runners.name: Thimble
runners.spotlight: Second foal of a 1m3f-1m6f winner (RPR 102), herself from the family of Oaks winner Look Here; bred to have a future but this trip perhaps on the sharp side on debut.

runners.comment: 14,000gns half-sister to six winners; pedigree suggests further will suit better in time
runners.name: Cracking Anna
runners.spotlight: 14,000gns yearling; half-sister to six winners including Bobby Kennedy (11.6f; RPR 67), Anna Jammeela (1m4f AW; RPR 64) Sir Maxalot (Italian 1m1f-1m3f) and Xilado (Spanish 1m1f/9.5f); dam Listed-placed 1m 2yo/10.4f Flat (101)/2m and 2m5f hurdle winner; longer trips should suit better in time.

runners.comment: 13,000euros yearling; dam a smart performer at up to 1m4f; pedigree makes her of interest
runners.name: Espanita
runners.spotlight: 13,000euros yearling; second foal of a 6.5f-1m3f winner (including South American Grade 1s; RPR 111); pedigree makes her of interest.

runners.comment: Modest form in two starts three months apart; improvement essential
runners.name: Hurricane Ann
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two starts three months apart; improvement essential.

runners.comment: 4,000gns yearling with two winning siblings; others bring stronger paper claims
runners.name: Ivat Ghia
runners.spotlight: 4,000gns yearling; fifth foal; closely related to 7f 2yo/1m winner Dalanijujo (RPR 96), half-sister to 7f AW winner First Kiss (76); dam 6f AW 2yo winner (63); others bring stronger paper claims.

runners.breeder: J Bernstein/R Haim/Manton Park Farms Ltd
runners.comment: Dam a 6f/7f winner (including AW; RPR 84); yard's newcomers usually better for a run
runners.name: Midnight Media
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns foal; third foal; dam 6f/7f winner (including AW; RPR 84), half-sister to French 1m1f Listed winner Nocturnal Secret; hooded for debut; yard's newcomers usually better for a run.

runners.comment: 15,000gns yearling; dam unraced sister to a winner in Italy; one of two newcomers for yard
runners.name: Spangle Moon
runners.spotlight: 15,000gns yearling; dam an unraced sister to a 1m2f winner in Italy; one of two newcomers for Jack Channon; market informative.

19:30.race_name: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Maiden Stakes (Rider Restricted Race) (GBB)

runners.comment: 66-1 and offered little in a 6f maiden at Wolverhampton last month
runners.name: Jubilee Time
runners.spotlight: 66-1 and offered little in a 6f maiden at Wolverhampton last month.

runners.comment: Encouraging third at Wolverhampton on debut in December (7f); capable of better
runners.name: Caviar Cowboy
runners.spotlight: Stable's newcomers are usually better for a run so his third at Wolverhampton in December (7f) was an encouraging start; likely he will need a good step forward but it's not out of the question.

runners.comment: Debut 3rd nothing special in form terms but open to improvement and looks a leading player
runners.name: Kodi Island
runners.spotlight: The form of his debut third (of six) at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) last July hasn't really been advertised but it was still a promising start to his career; gelded since; open to improvement and he looks a leading contender for a stable that farms these events on AW.

runners.comment: Modest form in two AW runs this winter (6f/7f); now tried in a hood
runners.name: Mohmentous
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two AW runs this winter (6f/7f); the addition of a hood isn't enough to tempt.

runners.comment: Second of eight at Lingfield on last month's debut (6f); open to improvement
runners.name: Silent Strike
runners.spotlight: Found only another newcomer (well backed) too strong on his debut at Lingfield three weeks ago (6f); should have more to offer and he's a strong contender.

runners.comment: Triple-figure prices and she made no impact in two 6f fillies' novices last month
runners.name: Sequential
runners.spotlight: Triple-figure prices and she made no impact in two 6f fillies' novices last month.

20:00.race_name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qual') (Rider Restricted Race)

runners.comment: C&D winner and on last winning mark; sharper for latest run; one to take seriously
runners.name: Powdering
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner at up to 8.3f; latest win came over C&D in September off this mark; some fair runs in defeat since and she should be sharper with her recent return from a break behind her; one to consider.

runners.breeder: Hellwood Stud Farm & G P Clarke
runners.comment: Two fair runs this year without matching her best; needs to raise game to repeat 2025 win
runners.name: Shallow
runners.spotlight: Two-time C&D winner; well handicapped on last season's best and she has run creditably in two runs this year; she will need to raise her game if she is to repeat last year's win in the corresponding event.

runners.comment: C&D winner on a good mark; sharper for last month's return; one to consider
runners.name: Al Barez
runners.spotlight: It's been a while since his last win but conditions suit and he has slipped down the weights; ran okay over C&D five weeks ago (after a 98-day break); one for the shortlist.

runners.comment: Strong at the finish in last two starts; fully effective over C&D; each-way claims again
runners.name: Amazonian Dream
runners.spotlight: Three solid efforts this year, finishing off her race well at Lingfield 11 days ago (6f; cheekpieces first time); nudged back up 1lb but this C&D winner shouldn't be underestimated.

runners.comment: Not shone in two runs for current stable but he drops in class today
runners.name: Irish Nectar
runners.spotlight: Failed to win in 2025 but he wasn't beaten far at Pontefract on his final run for Kevin Ryan; yet to fire for current stable but this represents a drop in class.

runners.comment: Good C&D run last month but lesser effort over 5f latest; change of accessories today
runners.name: Mission Command
runners.spotlight: Placed over C&D last month; not quite so good at Newcastle two weeks ago (5f); tongue tie left off tonight and cheekpieces return; others look stronger.

runners.comment: Newcastle win (6f) last month before lesser run at Lingfield (awkward start); can revive
runners.name: Ziggys Condor
runners.spotlight: Off the mark for the year with a narrow 6f success at Newcastle last month; hamstrung by an awkward start at Lingfield 11 days ago; type to bounce back quickly.

runners.comment: Conditions fine and he arrives in fair form; no surprise to see him involved again
runners.name: Charlie Mason
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; had a good spell in the second half of 2025 and he has been running creditably without winning back on AW this winter; shouldn't be far away.

runners.comment: Won his last two but still 5lb lower than for C&D win last March; leading contender
runners.name: Supreme King
runners.spotlight: Beaten a short head by Shallow in this race last year and was rated 4lb higher at the time; comes here chasing a hat-trick after narrow wins at Southwell and Newcastle; leading claims.

runners.comment: Made all over 5f at Chelmsford last month; up 5lb in a stronger race so more is needed
runners.name: Merrimack
runners.spotlight: Recorded his first AW success (four turf wins) when making all in a 5f handicap at Chelmsford six weeks ago; up 5lb and in a deeper race so he will need more to follow up.

runners.comment: C&D win as a 3yo; absent 632 days and drawn widest; has been gelded; now tongue tied
runners.name: Auric
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in April 2024, his second start; well short of his best in two runs in May of that year and absent since; has been gelded during his spell on the sidelines and returns with a tongue tie fitted; best watched from the widest draw though.

runners.comment: 0-8 but has shown winning potential; drawn wide back from a four-month break
runners.name: Rory Rocket
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden but he did run some solid races in defeat last year, including one attempt on Polytrack; drawn wide back from a break though and others appeal more.

20:30.race_name: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Rider Restricted) (London Middle Distance Qual') (GBBPlus)

runners.comment: Two wins last autumn before coming up short in a Class 2; still has low mileage
runners.name: Solarize
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m2f novice at Chelmsford in October and followed up in 1m4f handicap at Wolverhampton one month later; came up short in his hat-trick bid at Southwell 12 weeks ago but that was a Class 2; still has low mileage and he commands respect.

runners.comment: Fair hurdle form last summer but he returns to the Flat off a tough mark
runners.name: Nap Hand
runners.spotlight: Still 2lb higher than for his Newbury win in October 2024 (1m2f, heavy); fair hurdle form last summer but more to prove back on the Flat.

runners.comment: Yet to add to debut win but on a handy mark and lots of form that makes him of interest
runners.name: Son Of Man
runners.spotlight: 20 defeats have followed a successful racecourse debut but he has run several good races during that barren spell; down to a career-low mark and apprentice Connor Planas is good value for his 3lb claim; each-way shout.

runners.comment: 0-6 but showed promise last year, including here; may do better as a 4yo
runners.name: Criminal
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden but he has displayed clear signs of ability and has been placed in both handicap runs; effective at this track and should be capable of better as a 4yo.

runners.comment: Course win last February; ready win at Newcastle last month; up 6lb but far from exposed
runners.name: Selenic
runners.owner: Sir F Brooke & Sir R Pilkington
runners.spotlight: 1m novice win here 12 months ago; beaten favourite on her handicap debut/return from 11-month absence last month but she left that behind with an easy Newcastle win four weeks ago (1m2f); that form hasn't worked out and she is 6lb higher in a stronger race but still likely she has more to offer.

runners.comment: Has done well over hurdles for new yard; could transfer that progress now back on the Flat
runners.name: Hamlets Night
runners.spotlight: Still seeking a first Flat win but he has taken well to hurdles for his new trainer, winning twice last September and last seen finishing a close second in Grade 2 at Wincanton 102 days ago; no surprise to see him on the premises.

runners.comment: Good third over C&D two weeks ago (after a break); competitive with a repeat
runners.name: Golden Circet
runners.owner: W Trenchard A Coupland Cheam Marketng
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins last summer; good third over C&D on his return from a 12-week break; dangerous with a repeat.

runners.breeder: Floors Stud Ltd & The Duke Of Devonshire
runners.comment: Midfield in two 1m2f handicap runs; up in trip and not fully exposed just yet
runners.name: Desert Heart
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has finished midfield in two 1m2f handicaps; should be sharper with last month's reappearance behind him but improvement is required for the new, longer trip.

runners.comment: Struggled in two runs last year and again on his reappearance; risky despite reduced mark
runners.name: Torcello
runners.spotlight: Veteran who struggled in two runs last year and fared no better when last of six over 2m here six weeks ago; down in the weights but has too much to prove for now.
